title: John Lennon addresses The Festival Of Life in London | 1970
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono addressed crowds at The Festival Of Life in London on 29 March 1970.

The event took place in Victoria Park near Bethnal Green, and was sponsored by the Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament (CND).

Although billed as a “special surprise item arranged by John and Yoko,” they did not attend in person. Instead, a telephone call with radio DJ John Peel was broadcast to the crowd.

Lennon broke the news that he and Ono were expecting a baby, due in October. “If we have a baby,” he told Peel, “we have to get peace so that it can survive.” The call ended with a rendition of ‘Give Peace A Chance’.
